payload.body: Failure pattern seen live (2026-07-29, speed-count-game): when a tool in the loop fails strangely, agents silently ABANDON the nahel workflow instead of erroring inside it. rtk 0.36 had a slash-ref bug suppressing git diff output (fixed in rtk 0.44.1) plus a cursor sandbox permission issue; codex kicked out of the nahel flow and drove cursor directly, which committed to main in the shared working tree with no worktree. Operational facts: unattended cursor dispatch needs --force --sandbox enabled --trust; codex's own sandbox blocks ps (fails nahel's pgid test). Backlog: f35q1rax (sandbox preflight), hk0wvqhq (fail-inside-the-flow workflow language).
